component.name: 伝え handheld-device cleanroom line — R0 building + equipment + device BOM

properties.name: sarutahiko:note
properties.value: R0 design BOM for a 48m x 30m Class-100k cleanroom SMT + final-assembly line producing the ≤200g open-SoC handheld of ADR-2605261300, PLUS the device BOM (group P) — the smartphone supply chain. Plant shell (A-E) + utilities (G/H/J) + site (K) + raw (L) as kami-genesis geometry; production equipment (F) = SMT line + assembly cells + display laminator + firmware flash + RF chamber + EOL bench. Device parts (P) carry :supplier-did (silicon/igata/hikari internal, else :representative external) + :gate. Manufacturer/MPN/qty/mass are representative R0 design figures, NOT a finalized purchase, 確認申請, 消防同意, 受電/受水契約, or 電波法/技適 certification. Open-SoC only (G9); proprietary SoC is absent by construction (N1). R3 community-scale ≤10,000/yr is Council + LANDS.md gated.
